question: If a creature's power changes after blockers are chosen, can that make an attacking creature with skulk become unblocked?

expected.shortAnswer: No: skulk matters only as blockers are chosen, so later changes do not unblock it.
expected.answer: Skulk matters only as blockers are chosen. Modifying either creature’s power after blockers are chosen won’t cause the attacking creature to become unblocked.
